value.rationale: Every unweighted finite cycle gets exact optimal real and complex mean-zero l1-to-energy constants and all extremizers. A nontrivial strict concavity on gap lengths proves that real extremizers are localized half-cycle sign potentials whereas complex extremizers are Fourier waves; the ratio converges to pi/(2 sqrt(3)), a persistent field-dependent structural gap. This natural periodic analogue is not a mere rephrasing of standard spectral-gap Cauchy--Schwarz (which is not sharp over reals).
